texts.label: text
texts.orig: The part after the preposition is considered additional information,  not  an  integral  part  of  the  subject.  But  sports  is teamwork.  It's  not  only  the  captain  but  also  the  team  which failed to qualify for the African National Cup Finals. So, we need to use conjunction 'and' in place of the preposition 'with'. Hence, 'captain and his team' is the most appropriate answer.
